value.rationale: This is the first nontrivial two-run specialization of a fresh bounded-one-run reconstruction theorem: it settles sharpness of its unrestricted-opponent upper bound, proves a natural first obstruction length, and establishes uniqueness of that boundary fiber by reproducible complete finite verification. The witness extends the lower bound to all longer words; this goes beyond a disconnected finite count.
